title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - Measure
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/Measure. Defines a specific measure taken, including related legal documentation.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Measure'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

legalDocuments.description: Relationship. Legal documents associated with the measure. Links to one or more LegalDocument entities.
